primary_source: Sharada Dwivedi & Rahul Mehrotra, Bombay: The Cities Within (1995)
secondary_sources: Sahapedia - tanks and pyaaus of Bombay
Gillian Tindall, City of Gold: The Biography of Bombay (1982)
note: Partial, documented inventory of Mumbai's lost and shrunken tanks (talao). South Mumbai's island-era tanks were largely filled in during the nineteenth century once the Vihar/Tulsi/Tansa piped supply arrived; many survive only as place names (C.P. Tank, Gowalia Tank, Dhobi Talao). Not an exhaustive list.

lost_bodies.name: Framji Cowasji Tank
lost_bodies.note: Philanthropic tank near the Esplanade, filled in as the fort glacis was cleared.
lost_bodies.location_basis: Site opposite Metro Cinema at the Dhobi Talao junction; commemorative plaque survives

lost_bodies.name: Cowasji Patel Tank
lost_bodies.note: Filled in the late 19th century; the C.P. Tank locality is named after it.
lost_bodies.location_basis: Site is today's C.P. Tank Circle, Bhuleshwar/Girgaon

lost_bodies.name: Gowalia Tank
lost_bodies.note: Drained; the site is now August Kranti Maidan.
lost_bodies.location_basis: Site is today's August Kranti Maidan, Grant Road West

lost_bodies.name: Babula Tank
lost_bodies.note: Filled in; survives as Babula Tank Road.
lost_bodies.location_basis: Survives as Babula Tank Road along JJ Hospital's western wall

lost_bodies.name: Mumbadevi Tank
lost_bodies.note: The old tank beside the Mumbadevi temple, filled in the 1870s-80s.
lost_bodies.location_basis: Tank fronted the surviving Mumbadevi Temple, Bhuleshwar; filled 1890s

lost_bodies.name: Dhobi Talao
lost_bodies.note: Filled; the Dhobi Talao junction keeps the name.
lost_bodies.location_basis: Locality name survives at the Metro Cinema junction

lost_bodies.name: Two Tanks (Do Tanki)
lost_bodies.note: Paired tanks filled in; survives as the Do Tanki locality.
lost_bodies.location_basis: Now the Do Tanki junction, Maulana Azad Rd; 'Two Tanks' bus stop survives

lost_bodies.name: Khara Talao
lost_bodies.note: Brackish tank near Null Bazaar, filled in.
lost_bodies.location_basis: Survives as Khara Tank Road, Kumbharwada near Null Bazaar

lost_bodies.name: Cavel Tank
lost_bodies.location_basis: Cavel village locality centroid, Kalbadevi; no surviving marker

lost_bodies.name: Nawab Tank
lost_bodies.location_basis: Survives as Nawab Tank Road, Mazgaon; site now a playground

lost_bodies.name: Bandra Talao (Lake)
lost_bodies.note: Surviving tank near Bandra, much reduced and encroached.
lost_bodies.location_basis: Still exists as Swami Vivekanand Sarovar, S.V. Road, Bandra West

lost_bodies.name: Masjid Bandar tanks
lost_bodies.note: Cluster of small tanks largely lost to dense built fabric.
lost_bodies.location_basis: Locality centroid at Masjid railway station; one spring-fed tank survives in the Jama Masjid courtyard

lost_bodies.name: Pydhonie tank
lost_bodies.note: The 'foot-washing' tank that gave Pydhonie its name; long since built over.

_location_note: Coordinates are approximate present-day sites of the historical tanks (surviving landmarks, road names, locality centroids), researched Jul 2026; confidence per entry. The tanks themselves no longer exist except where noted.
